content: Intuitively, we expect a high value of $S_{W, V}^A$ to lead to a lower robustness of the downstream classifier, since the adversary has more degrees of freedom to attack the classifier. Thus, when using word recognition as a defense, it is prudent to design a low sensitivity system with a low error rate. However, as we will demonstrate, there is often a trade-off between sensitivity and error rate.
